transport: Exactly one GET per URL, no retry/fallback/contract or order, <=30s. Keep raw response body/status/sanitized headers, hash, NAS remote scoped restore. Stop on any non-200 or invalid Yahoo chart schema.
source_role: Independent Yahoo daily quote snapshot to test whether the two source-selected physical-account loss intervals overlap large semiconductors ETF market moves and whether split/dividend events appear. Yahoo close/next close and open/next open are not the Stage1 09:47-to-09:47 marks; adjusted history is current-vintage QA only, not PIT feature or exact net account proof.
analysis: Require positive finite daily OHLC on Jul6/7 and Jul27/28 for both symbols, unique New York trade dates, no rows dropped. Report Yahoo raw quote open-to-next-open and close-to-next-close SOXL-minus-SOXX simple spreads and per-symbol percent returns; compare direction/magnitude descriptively with saved Stage1 raw 09:47 relative forward return and physical selection loss. Enumerate all div/split events in the July window and flag events on the four named dates. Do not assert exact equality across clocks/vendors.
stop: Source identity/receipt or date/price schema failure stops. No strategy rule, factor, account or promotion based on hindsight-selected days. If independent quote disagreement is material, separate source-quality investigation must precede feature work.
